title: Apple releases iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate 27 with Siri AI and Liquid Glass refinements
summary: This is also the last version of macOS to support Rosetta for Intel apps.
reason: Media-only coverage (Ars Technica) of Apple's OS release with Siri AI. No official Apple announcement/model card link, so R1 does not apply; it is a non-model product launch reported by reputable media, which fits R3.
